mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales exceeding 0.5% from the prior month indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: During recessions, a monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 1.0% signals deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations adjust to weaker corporate output.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative during recessions when INDPRO declines > 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year recession window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5%, it signals aggressive monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and economic stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate level (above 7.5%) consistently correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as elevated joblessness suppresses consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 7.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 500.0 thousand units signal a severe housing market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the real estate sector's downturn impacts broader economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 500.0 (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the federal funds rate and payroll employment exceeding 0.1 percentage points and 100.0 thousand persons, respectively, signal a coordinated monetary and labor market response to economic distress, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines > 0.1pp and PAYEMS declines > 100.0 from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both FEDFUNDS declines > 0.1pp and PAYEMS declines > 100.0 (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).
